font_rules: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for headlines/H1/H2. Headlines MUST use uppercase Barlow Condensed/Oswald heavy weight (font-black / font-extrabold) with tracking-wider.
H1 max size is text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl. Fluid scaling clamp without text overlap.
Overlines / badges must be text-xs or text-sm uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-[0.25em]) in Safety Orange.
Body text should be clean, highly legible inter with leading-relaxed.

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files not .tsx files, so write all React components as .js files.
Import Lucide icons (Wrench, Truck, ShieldCheck, Phone, Mail, MapPin, Clock, Gauge, Disc, Cog, Cpu, CheckCircle2, ArrowRight) cleanly.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling or Framer Motion scroll reveals for an award-winning craft feel.
Ensure sticky header has a persistent 'Request Service' button and a tap-to-call phone button for mobile.
Include data-testid attributes on ALL interactive elements (buttons, form inputs, links, call cards) according to testing specifications.
Form submission must validate fields, simulate a real loading state, and render a rich success confirmation message.
Create routing/pages for main landing page (/), Privacy Policy (/privacy), and Terms of Service (/terms) using React Router.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Avoid generic light SaaS templates. Use high contrast, heavy industrial borders, bold typography, safety orange highlights, and authentic commercial repair imagery.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_test_ids: Mandatory data-testid attributes on buttons, inputs, headers, navigation items, and forms.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_check: Ensure white/orange text on dark surfaces meets high contrast APCA standards.
